caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of woven textile or tapestry. The piece is divided vertically into two main sections: the left section is filled with irregular red patterns interspersed with white and bordered by a narrow strip of green on its far left edge, while the right section is dominated by a blue background featuring a white bird, possibly a dove, perched among stylized floral or leafy motifs. The two sections are separated by a jagged vertical division. At the bottom of the swatch, the textile appears to have frayed edges, with the red side blending into light pinkish-red and the blue side transitioning into a darker blue-gray. The background of the image is a plain, unmarked light beige, and there is a handwritten inscription and date near the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Jacquard Coverlet (Detail)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
